nodes.description: Foundation Phase (Grades R-3)

nodes.title: Grade 3
nodes.description: Grade 3

nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.description: Mathematics for Grade 3 — Foundation Phase CAPS

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Grade 3 Mathematics Term 1 (45 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 180-200; number concept to 500; place value (hundreds, tens and units); order and compare numbers; addition and subtraction to 99; fractions (halves, quarters, thirds, fifths)

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Geometric patterns: copy, extend, describe and create; number patterns: extend, describe and create; input and output number patterns

nodes.title: Space and Shape (Geometry)
nodes.description: Position and directions: describe position using directions; 3D objects: sort, describe and compare

nodes.title: Measurement — Time
nodes.description: Time: telling time to nearest 5 minutes on analogue clocks; read and write dates; sequence events from own life

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect and sort data; represent data in pictographs and bar graphs; discuss and report on sorted data

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Grade 3 Mathematics Term 2 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 200-500; number concept to 500; addition and subtraction to 400; multiplication (×2, ×3, ×4, ×5, ×10); division; money: solve money problems

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Number patterns: extend and describe including skip counting in 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s, 10s; geometric patterns: extend, describe and create

nodes.title: Space and Shape — 2D Shapes
nodes.description: 2D shapes: sort, describe, compare and identify; properties of 2D shapes including sides, angles and corners; symmetry in 2D shapes

nodes.title: Measurement — Mass
nodes.description: Mass: estimate, measure, compare and order using grams and kilograms; read and record mass on bathroom and kitchen scales

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, sort and organise data; represent data in bar graphs; answer questions about bar graphs and pictographs

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Grade 3 Mathematics Term 3 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 500-700; number concept to 1000; addition and subtraction to 700; multiplication and division; fractions (unitary and non-unitary fractions of whole numbers and shapes)

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Number patterns: extend and describe; input and output tables; number sentences with missing numbers

nodes.title: Space and Shape — Position and Directions
nodes.description: Position and directions: follow and give directions; position of objects using maps and grids

nodes.title: Measurement — Time and Capacity/Volume
nodes.description: Time: telling time to nearest minute; calculate elapsed time; Capacity/Volume: estimate, measure, compare and order in millilitres and litres

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, organise and represent data; interpret data in bar graphs and pictographs; write sentences about data

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Grade 3 Mathematics Term 4 (49 days)

nodes.title: Numbers, Operations and Relationships
nodes.description: Count to 700-1000; number concept to 1000; addition and subtraction to 999; multiplication (×2 to ×10) and division; fractions: unitary and non-unitary fractions; money: solve money problems with change

nodes.title: Patterns, Functions and Algebra
nodes.description: Number patterns: extend, describe and create; geometric patterns: extend, describe and create; number sentences: solve and complete

nodes.title: Space and Shape — Symmetry
nodes.description: Symmetry: recognise and draw lines of symmetry; 3D objects: sort, describe and build; 2D shapes making faces of 3D objects

nodes.title: Measurement — Time
nodes.description: Time: reading timetables and calendars; calculate days and months; Perimeter: measure perimeter of 2D shapes in centimetres

nodes.title: Data Handling
nodes.description: Collect, sort, represent and interpret data; bar graphs; answer questions and write sentences about data; likelihood of events
